paper_title: Module 1 Cheat Sheet - Introduction to Linux
section: List files and directories in a directory:
text: ls path\_to\_directory Return path to present working directory: pwd Change the current directory to a subdirectory: cd child\_directory\_name Tip: Because cd looks in the current directory for child\_directory\_name, you don't need to type the entire path.

paper_title: Module 1 Cheat Sheet - Introduction to Linux
text: Up one level: cd ../ To home: cd ~

section: Change the current directory to another one at the same level:
text: Suppose you have two sibling directories within the same directory, dir\_1 and dir\_2, and your present working directory is dir\_1. To switch to dir\_2, enter: ``` None ``` ``` cd ../dir_2 ``` Tip: Using .., you don't need to know the path to the parent directory to switch to a sibling.
